company_notes: Context: mid-market support platform with multi-tenant customers; primary product is a hosted help center + chat widget.
Scale: ~52M historical support artifacts (articles, tickets, KB snippets) to be indexed initially; nightly incremental ingest expected.

Latency requirements: end-to-end RAG (retrieve + rerank + generation) P95 target <= 200ms for chat deflection flows. CTO quote: 'We cannot accept >200ms P95 for UI flows; tokenization and rerank must be invisible to user.'
Reranking expectation: top-5 quality high — want top-5 MRR > 0.92 on our eval set; will provide 10k labeled dev pairs for offline tests.
Cost constraint: target blended cost-per-query < $0.02 at current query mix (avg 2.3 retrievals per session), they care about per-tenant cost visibility.
Preferred model footprint: open models preferred for cost control; willing to evaluate quantized reranker variants. Also asked about model variants for fallback (small local vs hosted large).
Operational needs: per-tenant data residency (EU customers), strict retention controls, audit logs for re-training provenance. KMS integration required for private deployment.
POC success metrics: ingest 50M docs in 2 days (dry-run), retrieval p95 < 80ms for vector lookup, reranker latency < 75ms, top-5 quality thresholds met on eval set, clear SLA for fallbacks.
Notes: interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching and quantization) to hit cost target. Wants transparent token-level breakdown in Console to attribute costs to features/tenants.
Stakeholders: CTO (A. Nguyen), Head of Support Ops (Maya Lopez), Lead Data Engineer (Rohan Patel). Security reviewers: Julian (infosec).
Quote from Support Ops: 'If deflection increases by 30% we can reallocate headcount — big upside, but we need rock-solid latency & explainability on suggestions.'
Internal AE pointer: propose Dedicated baseline with VPC peering and Private plan for EU tenant subset; include one-week in-region performance test as part of contract.
Risk: budget approval cycles push to Q1; they may run competitive POC with Pinecone+custom reranker if Redwood can't show indexing/latency numbers quickly.
